articles.headline: English and Welsh FAs withdraw support for Gianni Infantino FIFA re-election
articles.description: The English and Welsh associations have formally withdrawn their support for Gianni Infantino as the pressure continues to mount on the FIFA president.

articles.headline: UEFA threatens Gianni Infantino with legal action over World Cup sell-off plan - sources
articles.description: UEFA has raised the possibility that it might take legal action against Gianni Infantino over his World Cup sell-off plan, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Vozinha mobbed by fans as he arrives in Chile to join Colo Colo

articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: There's nothing like a World Cup to put young stars in the shop window! With that in mind, ESPN has assembled a list of all the Socceroos' post-tournament transfers, all in one place.

articles.headline: Andy Burnham: Gianni Infantino isn't the right man to lead FIFA - we can't 'move on and forget' World Cup plan
articles.description: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has doubled down on his call for change at the top of FIFA, insisting football cannot "move on and forget."

articles.headline: Real Madrid thank UEFA for 'protecting football' after FIFA abandon private equity proposal
articles.description: Real Madrid have praised UEFA for helping protect football "at a decisive moment" after FIFA abandoned plans to sell stakes in a World Cup company to private investors.
